summary: FACT II Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting termination of its Business Combination Agreement with Precision Aerospace Defense Group (PAD), dated Nov 26, 2025 and amended May 17, 2026. Termination occurred on July 16, 2026 per the agreement's terms. Concurrently, the Sponsor Support Agreement and PAD Support Agreements also terminated. No break fee, price, or premium was disclosed. The SPAC will now seek a new target or face liquidation. Risk-arb investors should watch for a potential extension vote or return of trust proceeds.
